segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey, quick gut check on the Osprey expansion quote. They asked for 24 more editor seats starting August 12, co-termed to their April 30 agreement. I have it at $38 per seat per month after the standard 12% discount.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Yeah, that matches the pricing sheet. Are they still keeping the 86 viewer seats, or did procurement try to swap any of those down?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: No swap. Same 86 viewers, plus the 24 editors. Their ops lead was pretty specific because they want the new plant managers live before the September training.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Okay. Then the only thing is billing frequency. Their current setup is annual upfront, so if they add mid-term, the invoice should just be the prorated amount through April 30.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right, I got $6,716 for the prorated piece. While I was in the billing tool I saw the Halberg line only shows through tomorrow and the last customer thread I can find is from May, which, yeah, not great. Anyway, Osprey is clean.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Got it. For Osprey, make sure the order form says the added seats inherit the existing support terms. Deal desk kicked one back last week because that sentence was missing.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, I put that in the notes section and the cover page. Legal language stays untouched. They asked if the invoice can reference PO 44718-A, so I added that too.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Perfect. Send it over as-is. If they sign by Friday, implementation can still hold the August 12 enablement slot.
